title: Night Vision 2
description: lightweight, simple, toggleable, permission based nightvision (/nv) plugin.
body:
Simply type /nightvision! (or /nv)
![Simply type /nightvision!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d8deb99f59e3319cb4b8c8e410bafd783847bc66_0.webp)
config:
```messages:
  prefix: "&8[&bNightVision&8] "
  enabled: "&7Night Vision has been enabled..."
  disabled: "&7Night Vision has been disabled..."
  no-permission: "&cYou don't have permission to use this command."
  players-only: "&cOnly players can use this command!"

sound:
  enabled: true
  type: "BLOCK_AMETHYST_BLOCK_BREAK"
  volume: 1.0
  pitch: 1.0```
